description: Forced-angle I-f current FOC at the speed six-step settles to, with the current magnitude matched to six-step phase RMS for equal copper loss.
notes: Captured live over mmc-proto at 990 Hz effective; 7949 frames, 0 rejected.
Matched-speed pair with six.csv. 0.23 A commanded gives 0.1754 A phase RMS against six-step 0.1688 A — matched within 4 %.
Current-vector ripple 8.4 % sd / 36.8 % pk-pk, i.e. 3.3x smoother than six-step.

Forced angle, not closed-loop sensorless: the flux observer stalls at this speed (back-EMF is only ~47 mV at 52 rad/s electrical), so sensorless FOC could not be the counterpart here. Rotor sync therefore cannot be confirmed from telemetry alone.
title: Matched-speed comparison: I-f current FOC, 52.3 rad/s el
